name: comp-497
blurb: Dropdowns select month and year instead of arrows.
description: A calendar with month/year selection via dropdown menus instead of prev/next navigation arrows.
use_when: You need fast year/month navigation (especially for historical dates).
avoid_when: When quick month-by-month browsing is the main use case.
a11y: Dropdowns with aria-label. Selection changes trigger calendar update.
